def matrix_after(text, marker, n=28):
 s=text.split(marker,1)[1].lstrip('\n')
 lines=s.splitlines()[:n]
 g=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in lines]
 assert len(g)==n and all(len(row)==n for row in g), (len(g),[len(row) for row in g])
 return g

def infer_period(grid):
 scores=period_scores(grid)
 maxrate=max(v[2] for v in scores.values())
 # Prefer shortest period among essentially tied best candidates.
 return min(p for p,v in scores.items() if v[2] >= maxrate-1e-12)
def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
 p=infer_period(grid)
 out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if out[r][c]!=0: continue
   if r<2 or c<2: out[r][c]=1
   elif r==2 or c==2: out[r][c]=4
   else:
    candidates=Counter(grid[r][cc] for cc in range(3,w) if grid[r][cc] and cc%p==c%p)
    if not candidates:
     # fallback vertical inference for rare missing entire row class
     candidates=Counter(grid[rr][c] for rr in range(3,h) if grid[rr][c] and rr%p==r%p)
    out[r][c]=candidates.most_common(1)[0][0]
 return out
print('periods',infer_period(demo_in),infer_period(test))
res=transform(demo_in)
diffs=[(r,c,res[r][c],demo_out[r][c]) for r in range(28) for c in range(28) if res[r][c]!=demo_out[r][c]]
